_comment: Requires the 'Required quality' check to pass on the default branch before a PR can merge. strict_required_status_checks_policy forces the branch to be up to date, so a check that passed against stale base code cannot carry a merge. This rule is what makes the gate binding; without it the workflow only reports. Pair it with required-quality-integrity.json, which protects the workflow definition itself.
name: required-quality-check
